metadata.title: CISA SCuBA to NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 Control Mapping

provenance.mapping-description: Derived from CISA's published SCuBA to NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 (FedRAMP High) crosswalk, with policy identifiers resolved through CISA's baseline migration table where they changed between baseline versions. Mappings CISA has not published are marked ai-proposed and carry a numeric confidence score; they are never merged into the authoritative set.

coverage.generation-method: ratio of SCuBA policies with a resolved NIST mapping
